desc: Residential organics collected in Brooklyn, composted, and demanded by urban farms. The demand-to-facility step is a labelled bridge in the app, not a sample edge.

desc: Yard waste pyrolysed to biochar, demanded by a waste processor. The processor-to-plant step is a labelled bridge in the app, not a sample edge.

NYC Curbside Compost Loop
desc: Public programme loop, sourced 2026-10-27: mandatory citywide curbside organics -> aerobic composting at the Staten Island Compost Facility -> compost demanded by community gardens, distributed via GetCompost. The garden-to-facility step is a labelled bridge: gardens do not operate the facility, and no public per-garden tonnage ledger exists.
source: DSNY curbside composting page; DSNY Staten Island Compost Facility page; EPA WARM v15

name: Newtown Creek Biogas Loop
desc: Public programme loop, sourced 2026-10-27: restaurant food waste -> anaerobic co-digestion at Newtown Creek (DEP, ~250 t/day food scraps and FOG, via CORe slurry) -> biogas demanded by waste processors -> DEP facility. Output is biogas/RNG plus digestate, NOT garden compost; the demand-to-facility step is a labelled bridge.
source: NYSDEC Newtown Creek notice; DEP presentation slides
